theorems.name_zh: 完整加权作用核的质量类配对准则
theorems.assumptions: Fixed p,m,ports and positive ControlPacket; conjugation by a unit lattice frame.
theorems.statement: The weighted kernel is preserved iff conjugation bijects nonzero action-germ classes preserving their aggregate weight*count; atomwise equal-weight matching is not necessary.
theorems.boundary: Fixed p, action-germ precision, control identity and mass observer; no physical attribution, raw-path equivalence or infinite-lift claim.

theorems.name_zh: 不固定匹配的一位修复仿射纤维
theorems.assumptions: Guard depth N=m+C>=1; fixed coarse projective frame; full weighted kernel stabilizer.
theorems.statement: Every nonempty next-digit repair fiber is an affine F_p space of dimension<=35; full-chart liftable fibers have uniform cardinality at one level.
theorems.boundary: Fixed p, action-germ precision, control identity and mass observer; no physical attribution, raw-path equivalence or infinite-lift claim.

theorems.name_zh: 互斥匹配族的完整仿射合并证书
theorems.assumptions: Complete enumeration of compatible fine class matchings; exact linear solver, scalar uniqueness and independent correction chart.
theorems.statement: Projected matching families are disjoint; equality between their total cardinality and their affine hull cardinality certifies no spurious or omitted frames.
theorems.boundary: Fixed p, action-germ precision, control identity and mass observer; no physical attribution, raw-path equivalence or infinite-lift claim.

theorems.name_zh: 细分质量障碍与定量失配
theorems.assumptions: Same coarse seed; finer action-germ laws; fixed positive original mass.
theorems.statement: Sorted child-mass L1 mismatch/2 is a per-source lower bound on fine germ total variation. E_q splitting gives symmetry lifespan q and defect1/6. Zero bound is not sufficiency for a joint frame.
theorems.boundary: Fixed p, action-germ precision, control identity and mass observer; no physical attribution, raw-path equivalence or infinite-lift claim.

theorems.name_zh: 浅层替换的真实峰值失效见证
theorems.assumptions: Specified repeated-block X6 preparation/mixture/tail, fixed original probabilities, threshold3.
theorems.statement: The original and invalid shallow-conjugated-middle models have first hit only at tick3, with probabilities5/6 and3/4. Preparation spread2 lies outside the shallow threshold2 safe set.
theorems.boundary: Fixed p, action-germ precision, control identity and mass observer; no physical attribution, raw-path equivalence or infinite-lift claim.

theorems.name_zh: 可变配对多层续接及原BRC安全接入
theorems.assumptions: Declared seeds/chart/final depth; complete matches and frame expansion or explicit retained limits; parent weighted-row certification before execution.
theorems.statement: Finite-depth search is complete in the declared fiber/chart; limits preserve unresolved families. Certified frames integrate with the existing online peak quotient without changing original branch weights/counts.
